answer_1.quote: in this work we study the problem of automatic conclusion generation.

answer_2.quote: We report results for three evaluation measures: ROUGE-1, ROUGE-L, and BERTscore (F1-score).

answer_4.quote: We therefore also perform manual evaluation with human annotators on 30 randomly selected arguments from the test-split.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated conclusions on validity, novelty, and frame relatedness using specific questions.
